sql.if: AND ( title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR summary LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR tags LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO blog_posts ( wordpress_post_id, site_id, title, summary, content, category, status, tags, cover_image_url, wordpress_url, view_count, published_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{wordpressPostId}, #{siteId}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{content}, #{category}, #{status}, #{tags}, #{coverImageUrl}, #{wordpressUrl}, #{viewCount}, #{publishedAt}, #{updatedAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE title = VALUES(title), summary = VALUES(summary), content = VALUES(content), category = VALUES(category), status = VALUES(status), tags = VALUES(tags), cover_image_url = VALUES(cover_image_url), wordpress_url = VALUES(wordpress_url), view_count = VALUES(view_count), published_at = VALUES(published_at), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(published_at, '%m-%d') AS day, COUNT(*) AS count FROM blog_posts WHERE site_id = #{value} AND published_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(published_at, '%m-%d') ORDER BY day
